import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    a = int(data[0])
    b = int(data[1]) if len(data) > 1 else 0
    # Swap using pointers-style reference (Python list acts as pointers)
    ptr = [a, b]
    ptr[0], ptr[1] = ptr[1], ptr[0]
    print(ptr[0], ptr[1])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
